overview.title: Institute Overview
overview.description: Mohsin and Huma IT Center × SMIT is a technology education institute dedicated to providing free, high-quality training in modern technology skills. Our mission is to empower individuals with the knowledge and tools they need to succeed in the digital economy.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide accessible, high-quality technology education that empowers individuals to build successful careers, contribute to the digital economy, and create positive impact in their communities.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be a leading center of technology education that transforms lives through free, world-class training programs, creating a skilled workforce ready for the challenges of the digital age.

smit.title: Collaboration with SMIT
smit.description: In collaboration with Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), we bring structured, industry-aligned curriculum and a proven education methodology to serve our community.
